sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我在《纽约时报》的每日简报 Dealbook 负责商业与政策报道。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的真实对话。

sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.zh: 你绝对不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, an ugly power struggle has broken out inside the nation's preeminent gun rights group.
sentences.zh: 今天，全美最著名的枪支权利组织内部爆发了一场丑陋的权力争夺战。

sentences.en: How just the possibility of an investigation into its finances plunged the NRA into crisis.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是对其财务状况进行调查的可能性，是如何将美国步枪协会（NRA）推入危机之中的。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, April 30th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月30日，星期二。

sentences.en: The banners are up and exhibitors moving in for one of the city's largest and most polarizing conventions.
sentences.zh: 横幅已经挂起，参展商们正在进驻这座城市规模最大、也最具争议的会议之一。

sentences.en: It's the second time Indianapolis has hosted the NRA.
sentences.zh: 这是印第安纳波利斯第二次主办美国步枪协会的大会。

sentences.en: Beginning tomorrow, tens of thousands of people will be coming to downtown Indianapolis for the annual NRA convention.
sentences.zh: 从明天开始，数万人将涌入印第安纳波利斯市中心参加年度美国步枪协会大会。

sentences.en: When these convention doors open, this place is going to be transformed into the world's biggest family reunion with acres and acres of guns and gear.
sentences.zh: 当大会的大门打开时，这里将变成世界上最大的家庭聚会，到处都是数不清的枪支和装备。

sentences.en: Every year, the NRA holds an annual convention.
sentences.zh: 美国步枪协会每年都会举行一次年度大会。

sentences.en: This year, there were 15 acres of guns at the convention center in Indianapolis.
sentences.zh: 今年，印第安纳波利斯的会议中心展出了占地15英亩的枪支。

sentences.en: Already, you've got folks who are coming in from all around the country.
sentences.zh: 已经有来自全国各地的人们陆续赶来。

sentences.en: It's going to be a great weekend here in Indy.
sentences.zh: 这将在印第安纳波利斯迎来一个伟大的周末。

sentences.en: This year, however, the drama really was playing out behind the scenes.
sentences.zh: 然而今年，戏剧性的事件实际上是在幕后上演的。

sentences.en: Danny Hakem has been reporting on the NRA for The Times.
sentences.zh: 丹尼·哈凯姆一直在为《时报》报道美国步枪协会的新闻。

sentences.en: It was really the biggest leadership crisis that the group has had for many years, since the 1990s at least, between two of the top figures in the NRA.
sentences.zh: 这确实是该组织多年来遭遇的最大的领导层危机，至少自20世纪90年代以来从未有过，发生在协会的两位最高人物之间。

sentences.en: And it really has the potential to cause turmoil even beyond this weekend.
sentences.zh: 而且它确实有可能引发甚至超越这个周末的混乱。

sentences.en: So, Danny, where does all this turmoil inside the NRA begin?
sentences.zh: 那么，丹尼，美国步枪协会内部的所有这些混乱是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: Well, it might seem like something of a surprise, but the leadership turmoil within the NRA actually
sentences.zh: 嗯，这听起来可能有点令人意外，但美国步枪协会内部的领导层动荡实际上

sentences.en: can be traced back to the attorney general's campaign in the state of New York last summer.
sentences.zh: 可以追溯到去年夏天纽约州的州总检察长竞选。

sentences.en: Hi, it's Letitia James, and I just received a questionnaire from some of my friends, the NRA.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是莱蒂蒂亚·詹姆斯，我刚刚收到了来自我的朋友们——美国步枪协会的一份问卷。

sentences.en: That's when Letitia James was the frontrunner in that race at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时莱蒂蒂亚·詹姆斯是那场竞选中的领先者。

sentences.en: Do you really think they're going to endorse me?
sentences.zh: 你真的认为他们会支持我吗？

sentences.en: I'm going to fill it out anyway.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，我还是会把它填完。

sentences.en: Stay tuned.
sentences.zh: 请拭目以待。

sentences.en: And she began saying that she was going to investigate the NRA's tax-exempt status, because the NRA is a non-profit group.
sentences.zh: 她开始表示要调查美国步枪协会的免税地位，因为该协会是一个非营利组织。

sentences.en: She even at one point referred to the NRA as a terrorist organization.
sentences.zh: 她甚至在某个时刻将美国步枪协会称为恐怖组织。

sentences.en: And why is she talking about that in her campaign?
sentences.zh: 她为什么要在竞选活动中谈论这个？

sentences.en: Well, the NRA was actually chartered in the state of New York almost 150 years ago.
sentences.zh: 嗯，美国步枪协会实际上是在近150年前在纽约州注册成立的。

sentences.en: And the attorney general's office in New York has jurisdiction over tax-exempt entities set up in New York.
sentences.zh: 纽约州总检察长办公室对在纽约设立的免税实体拥有管辖权。

sentences.en: I mean, is that such a big deal to have the potential future attorney general of New York talking about the NRA's tax-exempt status, given how big and powerful this group is?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，考虑到这个组织体量如此庞大且势力强大，纽约未来的总检察长候选人公开谈论美国步枪协会的免税地位，这是一件大事吗？

sentences.en: It definitely got their attention.
sentences.zh: 这绝对引起了他们的注意。

sentences.en: She declared that we, that's you and me and all of us here, the law-abiding men and women of the National Rifle Association, are a terrorist organization.
sentences.zh: 她宣布我们——也就是你、我和这里的所有人，美国步枪协会遵纪守法的男男女女——是一个恐怖组织。

sentences.en: Within, you know, a few weeks of Tish James starting to say these things, the NRA began an audit just to prepare for a potential investigation.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在蒂什·詹姆斯开始发表这些言论几周内，美国步枪协会就发起了一次审计，以为潜在的调查做准备。

sentences.en: How do you feel about being called terrorist by the incoming attorney general in New York State?
sentences.zh: 被纽约州新任总检察长称为恐怖分子，你有什么感受？

sentences.en: Why does that line of investigation into its tax-exempt status make the NRA so nervous?
sentences.zh: 为什么针对其免税地位的调查会让美国步枪协会如此紧张？

sentences.en: What specifically about that classification is so important?
sentences.zh: 这种分类究竟有什么特别重要的意义？

sentences.en: Well, certainly if the NRA were to lose its tax-exempt status, it would have to start paying taxes, and that would make it a lot more expensive to operate.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当然，如果美国步枪协会失去免税地位，它就必须开始纳税，这会使其运营成本大幅增加。

sentences.en: That would really change its whole financial profile.
sentences.zh: 那将真正改变它的整个财务状况。

sentences.en: Okay, so the NRA launches this internal audit to essentially get their house in order in advance
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以美国步枪协会发起这项内部审计，本质上是为了整顿内部，以应对

sentences.en: of this pending investigation by the incoming New York attorney general that clearly they're pretty nervous about.
sentences.zh: 这位新任纽约总检察长即将展开的调查，他们显然对此感到相当紧张。

sentences.en: So what happens?
sentences.zh: 那么接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, they begin this internal audit, and in the NRA's telling, one of their largest and
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们开始了内部审计，但在美国步枪协会的说法中，他们最大、

sentences.en: longest-serving contractors refuses to turn over a lot of its documents and financial records.
sentences.zh: 合作时间最长的承包商之一拒绝交出大量的文书和财务记录。

sentences.en: Who is that, and why is that significant?
sentences.zh: 那是谁？为什么这很重要？

sentences.en: So the contractor that wouldn't turn over its records is a firm called Ackerman McQueen.
sentences.zh: 拒绝交出记录的承包商是一家名为奥格曼·麦奎因（Ackerman McQueen）的公司。

sentences.en: They're an Oklahoma-based advertising firm that has really created the modern voice of the NRA over more than three decades.
sentences.zh: 他们是一家总部位于俄克拉荷马州的广告公司，在三十多年的时间里，真正塑造了美国步枪协会的现代声音。

sentences.en: Greatness of America is displayed in our constitutional right to bear arms, a rich heritage and tradition that spans generations.
sentences.zh: 美国的伟大体现在我们拥有宪法赋予的持枪权利，这是一份跨越几代的丰富传统与遗产。

sentences.en: They came up with the I'm the NRA campaign back in the 80s.
sentences.zh: 他们在80年代提出了“我就是美国步枪协会”的活动口号。

sentences.en: And preserving all of this is the NRA, the National Rifle Association.
sentences.zh: 而保护这一切的就是美国步枪协会（NRA）。

sentences.en: They crafted a lot of the messaging for Charlton Heston when he was the president of the NRA.
sentences.zh: 查尔顿·赫斯顿担任美国步枪协会主席期间，他们为他策划了许多宣传信息。

sentences.en: So as we set out this year to defeat the divisive forces that would take freedom away, I want to say those fighting words from my cold, dead hands.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们今年着手击败那些企图剥夺自由的分裂力量时，我想说出那些战斗的誓言：从我冰冷僵硬的死手里拿走。

sentences.en: Good Friday to you.
sentences.zh: 祝您耶稣受难日快乐。

sentences.en: Welcome to NRA News.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收看美国步枪协会新闻。

sentences.en: They operate NRA TV.
sentences.zh: 他们运营着美国步枪协会电视台（NRA TV）。

sentences.en: A well-regulated militia being necessary to the security of a free state, the right of the people to keep and bear arms shall not be infringed.
sentences.zh: 管理良好的民兵是保障自由州安全所必需的，人民拥有和携带武器的权利不得侵犯。

sentences.en: Which is the NRA's online streaming service, which has really taken the NRA into a much sort of broadly harder edge than it's been before.
sentences.zh: 这是美国步枪协会的网络流媒体服务，它确实把美国步枪协会带向了一个比以往更广泛、更强硬的方向。

sentences.en: The only way we stop this, the only way we save our country and our freedom is to fight this violence of lies with the clenched fist of truth.
sentences.zh: 我们阻止这一切的唯一方法，我们拯救国家和自由的唯一方法，就是用紧握的真理铁拳去对抗谎言的暴力。

sentences.en: I'm the National Rifle Association of America, and I'm freedom's safest place.
sentences.zh: 我是美利坚合众国步枪协会，我是自由最安全的庇护所。

sentences.en: So when we think of the modern NRA, this company that I hadn't really heard of before,
sentences.zh: 所以当我们想到现代的美国步枪协会时，这家我以前没怎么听说过的公司，

sentences.en: Ackerman McQueen, they have created that identity, that brand.
sentences.zh: 奥格曼·麦奎因，他们创造了那种身份认同，那个品牌。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So why would this longtime partner of the NRA, who has created its modern identity successfully,
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么美国步枪协会这个长期合作伙伴，这个成功塑造了其现代身份的伙伴，

sentences.en: refuse to participate in this audit?
sentences.zh: 会拒绝参与这次审计？

sentences.en: Well, there's a lot of money at stake here.
sentences.zh: 这里面有巨额资金攸关。

sentences.en: The NRA directs more than $40 million annually to Ackerman McQueen.
sentences.zh: 美国步枪协会每年向奥格曼·麦奎因提供超过4000万美元的资金。

sentences.en: And there have been questions raised by the Times and other papers about how that money is being spent.
sentences.zh: 《时报》和其他报纸对这笔资金的使用方式提出了质疑。

sentences.en: And anytime you're dealing with a tax-exempt entity, you know, sending large amounts of
sentences.zh: 每当你处理一个免税实体向承包商输送大量资金的事务时，

sentences.en: money to a contractor, there have been questions raised about whether executives at the NRA have benefited personally from any of that money going to Ackerman.
sentences.zh: 人们就会质疑美国步枪协会的高管是否从流向奥格曼的任何资金中获得了个人利益。

sentences.en: And there's one contract in particular that has been a real point of contention between the two groups, and that's the contract of Oliver North, the president of the NRA.
sentences.zh: 其中有一份合同尤其成为了两个组织之间真正的争论焦点，那就是美国步枪协会主席奥利弗·诺斯的合同。

sentences.en: Wait, why does Oliver North have a contract with the agency that the NRA hires to do its marketing?
sentences.zh: 等等，为什么奥利弗·诺斯会和美国步枪协会聘请来做营销的机构签订合同？

sentences.en: Well, Oliver North was brought in as president of the NRA about a year ago.
sentences.zh: 嗯，奥利弗·诺斯大约在一年前被引入担任美国步枪协会主席。

sentences.en: And the presidency of the NRA has traditionally been a ceremonial poSt.
sentences.zh: 传统上，美国步枪协会的主席是一个礼仪性职位。

sentences.en: It's not been paid.
sentences.zh: 它是没有薪水的。

sentences.en: So the president has really been kind of a public face of the NRA, not an operational executive.
sentences.zh: 因此，主席实际上一直是美国步枪协会的一种公众形象代表，而不是运营高管。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: In this case, however, Oliver North wants to make money.
sentences.zh: 然而，在这种情况下，奥利弗·诺斯想要赚钱。

sentences.en: Racist, terrorist, traitor.
sentences.zh: 种族主义者、恐怖分子、叛徒。

sentences.en: These are names NRA members are called because we defend our flag, our national anthem, and the heroes they represent.
sentences.zh: 这些是美国步枪协会成员被贴上的标签，因为我们要捍卫我们的国旗、我们的国歌以及它们所代表的英雄。

sentences.en: So he ended up being paid by Ackerman McQueen to host a web show called Oliver North's American
sentences.zh: 因此，他最终接受了奥格曼·麦奎因公司的薪酬，去主持一个名为《奥利弗·诺斯的美国英雄》的网络节目。

sentences.en: Heroes.
sentences.zh: 英雄。

sentences.en: We're going to introduce you to American heroes, people who put themselves at risk for the benefit
sentences.zh: 我们将向你介绍美国英雄，那些为了他人利益而让自己置身于危险之中的人，

sentences.en: of others, because they're the ones who inspire us to be better people, better Americans, American heroes.
sentences.zh: 因为正是他们激励我们成为更好的人、更好的美国人——美国英雄。

sentences.en: And Danny, in whose interest is it that the NRA not see its president's contract with the
sentences.zh: 丹尼，美国步枪协会不希望别人看到其主席与该协会广告公司之间的合同，这符合谁的利益？

sentences.en: NRA's ad agency?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这不符合美国步枪协会的利益。

sentences.en: Well, it's not in the interest of the NRA.
sentences.zh: 看来奥格曼有某种理由不想透露该合同以及它与美国步枪协会关系的其它方面。

sentences.en: It seems like Ackerman had some reason for not wanting to disclose that contract and other aspects of its relationship with the NRA.
sentences.zh: 出于某种原因，他们不想交出财务记录，至少在美国步枪协会看来是这样的。

sentences.en: For some reason, they didn't want to turn over their financial records, at least as the NRA presents it.
sentences.zh: 从美国步枪协会的角度来看，他们需要全面了解所有高管和高层官员与所有承包商的关系，因为，

sentences.en: From the NRA's perspective, they need to have a full understanding of all their executives and
sentences.zh: 总检察长办公室的调查人员将会审查这类关系。

sentences.en: top officials' relationships with all of their contractors, because, you know, investigators
sentences.zh: 当高层官员从承包商那里获得个人经济利益时，这会给非营利组织带来麻烦。

sentences.en: for the attorney general's office are going to be looking at those kind of relationships.
sentences.zh: 那么，面对广告公司拒绝配合他们认为防御针对其税收状况调查所必需的审计，美国步枪协会作何反应？

sentences.en: And those can run nonprofits into trouble when top officials are getting personal financial benefits from contractors.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这导致美国步枪协会在几周前起诉了奥格曼·麦奎因公司，考虑到这两个组织多年来的密切关系，这确实是一个令人震惊的发展。

sentences.en: And so what is the reaction by the NRA to this refusal by its advertising company to comply with this audit that they feel they really need in order to be able to defend themselves
sentences.zh: 这真是一个令人惊讶的转折。

sentences.en: against this investigation into their tax status?
sentences.zh: 因此，美国步枪协会意识到自己可能容易受到莱蒂蒂亚·詹姆斯调查的攻击。

sentences.en: Well, it led to the NRA suing Ackerman McQueen a few weeks ago, which was really a stunning development given how close these two organizations have been over the years.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: It was a really surprising turn of events.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And so the NRA is realizing that it may be vulnerable to this investigation by Letitia
sentences.zh: 然后发生了什么？

sentences.en: James.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 因此，正是在这次大会上，这场丑陋的幕后权力斗争彻底公开化了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 就在大会开始前不久，奥利弗·诺斯给韦恩·拉皮埃尔的一位高级助手打了个电话。

sentences.en: And then what happens?
sentences.zh: 韦恩·拉皮埃尔多年来一直领导着美国步枪协会，诺斯称拉皮埃尔必须辞职。

sentences.en: So it's really at the convention that this really ugly backroom struggle burst out into the open.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Right before the convention starts, Oliver North makes a call to one of Wayne LaPierre's top aides.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他还表示如果拉皮埃尔不辞职，奥格曼将向董事会发送一封破坏性的信件，

sentences.en: Wayne LaPierre has run the NRA for many years, and he says that LaPierre needs to resign.
sentences.zh: 这封信对拉皮埃尔和其他一些高级官员来说都将具有毁灭性。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个赤裸裸的威胁。

sentences.en: More than that, he says if LaPierre doesn't resign, Ackerman is going to send a damaging letter
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: to the board, and it's going to be damaging both for LaPierre and some other high-ranking officials.
sentences.zh: 他还表示，如果拉皮埃尔辞职，诺斯将确保他获得一份丰厚的退休金。

sentences.en: So this is an outright threat.
sentences.zh: 听起来像是赤裸裸的贿赂。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是拉皮埃尔及其盟友对所发生事情的陈述。

sentences.en: And he also says that if LaPierre does resign, North will make sure that he gets a comfortable retirement package.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得这是勒索。

sentences.en: Which sounds like an outright bribe.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Well, this is the account that LaPierre and his allies have provided about what happened.
sentences.zh: 而且他对被威胁感到非常不满。

sentences.en: They felt like it was extortion.
sentences.zh: 他在第二天给董事会写了一封信。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 他是这样说的。

sentences.en: And he didn't take kindly to being threatened.
sentences.zh: 他说，昨天晚上，我被迫面临一个决定性的抉择，用勒索者的行话来说，就是一个我无法拒绝的提议。

sentences.en: And he wrote a letter to the board the next day.
sentences.zh: 我拒绝了。

sentences.en: Here's what he said.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: He said, yesterday evening, I was forced to confront one of those defining choices styled in the parlance of extortionists as an offer I couldn't refuse.
sentences.zh: 因此，美国步枪协会的两位领军人物、该组织级别最高的高官，正在互相发出威胁。

sentences.en: I refused it.
sentences.zh: 他们正试图排挤对方。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 让我震惊的是，仅仅是纽约州总检察长可能展开的一项调查，就在一个在我们大多数人看来基本上不可战胜的组织内部引发了如此大的混乱。

sentences.en: So the two leading figures of the NRA, the two most senior officials of this organization, they're trading threats.
sentences.zh: 这怎么可能呢？

sentences.en: They are trying to oust each other.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为美国步枪协会不一定像过去那样不可战胜了。

sentences.en: And I'm struck that it seems like just the possibility of an investigation by the New
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这件事发生时，枪支管控运动的资金正处于历史最高水平。

sentences.en: York Attorney General is causing this much havoc inside an organization that I think most of us think of as basically invincible.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: So how is that possible?
sentences.zh: 我今天在期中选举前夕向你们发表讲话。

sentences.en: Well, I don't think the NRA is necessarily as invincible as it might have been in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 在2018年的期中选举中，你可以看到枪支管控阵营资金的大量涌入。

sentences.en: I mean, this is happening at a time when the gun control movement is as well-financed as it's ever been.
sentences.zh: 你还可以看到由前纽约市长迈克尔·布隆伯格支持的组织。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 和你们一样，我怀着日益增长的惊恐观看了最近的爆炸案和大规模枪击事件。

sentences.en: I speak to you today on the eve of the midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 政治暴力撕裂了我们民主的核心。

sentences.en: In the 2018 midterms, you saw just an influx of money on the gun control side.
sentences.zh: 而针对神圣之所中宗教团体的暴力则撕裂了我们人性的核心。

sentences.en: And you saw groups backed by Michael Bloomberg, the former mayor of New York.
sentences.zh: 加比·吉福兹，那位遭枪击的前国会女议员。

sentences.en: Like you, I've watched the recent bombings and mass shootings with growing alarm.
sentences.zh: 你们有勇气去战斗吗？

sentences.en: Political violence tears at the heart of our democracy.
sentences.zh: 和我站在一起。

sentences.en: And violence against a religious group in a house of God tears at the heart of our humanity.
sentences.zh: 投票，投票，投票。

sentences.en: Gabby Giffords, the former congresswoman who was shot.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Do you have the courage to fight?
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Stand with me.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Vote, vote, vote.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Please join your voice with mine.
sentences.zh: 请将你的声音与我融为一体。

sentences.en: They really poured a lot of money into four house races where the incumbents had received
sentences.zh: 他们确实在四个众议院选区投入了巨资，而在这些选区中，现任议员此前曾获得

sentences.en: A ratings from the NRA and all four of those incumbents loSt.
sentences.zh: 美国全国步枪协会（NRA）的A级评定，结果这四位现任议员全部落选。

sentences.en: So things like that have made a difference in the debate.
sentences.zh: 因此，诸如此类的事情在辩论中产生了影响。

sentences.en: This guy with a gun we call BS.
sentences.zh: 对于这个持枪的家伙，我们直斥其无稽之谈。

sentences.en: And you also had a string of mass shootings that really mobilized sort of a new generation of activists.
sentences.zh: 而且你还经历了一系列大规模枪击事件，这确实动员了新一代的活动人士。

sentences.en: They say that us kids don't know what we're talking about, that we're too young to understand how the government works.
sentences.zh: 他们说我们这些孩子不知道自己在说什么，说我们太年轻，不懂政府是如何运作的。

sentences.en: And at the end of it all, the gun control groups outspent the NRA in the midterms, which really doesn't happen very often, if ever.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，在期中选举中，控枪集团的支出超过了NRA，这种情况如果不是绝无仅有，也确实非常罕见。

sentences.en: So that was a real sea change for the gun control movement.
sentences.zh: 因此，这对控枪运动来说是一个真正的重大转折。

sentences.en: So it seems like you're saying that this kind of investigation, it might not have caused this
sentences.zh: 所以听起来你的意思是，这种调查，可能并不会引发

sentences.en: much turmoil inside the NRA if the environment around the NRA wasn't shifting in the way that it now seems to be shifting.
sentences.zh: NRA内部如此大的动荡，如果NRA周边的环境没有像现在这样发生变化的话。

sentences.en: The NRA is seeing their opposition as more formidable, and they're reacting accordingly.
sentences.zh: NRA发现他们的反对者变得更加强大了，他们也正在作出相应的反应。

sentences.en: Yes, I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为是这样的。

sentences.en: So, Danny, once all this tension breaks out into the public, how does this convention end?
sentences.zh: 那么，丹尼，一旦所有这些紧张局势公开爆发，这次大会将如何收场？

sentences.en: The power struggle within the National Rifle Association has come to a breaking point.
sentences.zh: 美国全国步枪协会内部的权力斗争已经到了破裂的边缘。

sentences.en: The group's president, Oliver North, says that he will not return for a second term in office.
sentences.zh: 该集团的主席奥利弗·北（Oliver North）表示，他将不会寻求连任第二任期。

sentences.en: Over the last few days, Oliver North essentially appeared to be stepping aside.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几天里，奥利弗·北基本上表现得像是要退居幕后。

sentences.en: In a letter, the retired Marine lieutenant general wrote that he had hoped to be re-nominated
sentences.zh: 这位退休的海军陆战队中将在信中写道，他曾希望被重新提名

sentences.en: for a second one-year term as president, but was, quote, informed that would not happen.
sentences.zh: 竞选第二任期一年的主席职务，但据引述，他被“告知这不会发生”。

sentences.en: At the board meeting Monday, Wayne LaPierre was re-elected unanimously as the chief executive
sentences.zh: 在周一的董事会会议上，韦恩·拉皮埃尔（Wayne LaPierre）全票连任NRA

sentences.en: of the NRA, and Mr. North was replaced by a longtime member of the NRA, Carolyn Meadows, who was also elected unanimously.
sentences.zh: 首席执行官，而北先生则被NRA的资深成员卡罗琳·米多斯（Carolyn Meadows）取代，后者同样全票当选。

sentences.en: And this is a very large board with more than 70 members.
sentences.zh: 这是一个拥有70多名成员的非常庞大的董事会。

sentences.en: So it appeared to be a repudiation of Oliver North.
sentences.zh: 因此，这似乎是对奥利弗·北的一次公开谴责。

sentences.en: So the LaPierre side of this power struggle, the one arguing in favor of disclosure, in this case, prevails over the Oliver North camp, which was resisting it.
sentences.zh: 所以，这场权力斗争中拉皮埃尔的一派——也就是主张信息公开的一方——在这场较量中战胜了抗拒公开的奥利弗·北阵营。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It seemed like a very clear and decisive victory for Wayne LaPierre.
sentences.zh: 这看起来像是韦恩·拉皮埃尔取得了一场非常清晰且决定性的胜利。

sentences.en: And it potentially means the end of the relationship with Ackerman McQueen, the contractor.
sentences.zh: 这可能意味着与承包商阿克曼·麦奎因（Ackerman McQueen）的关系即将终结。

sentences.en: And that, you know, that really has the potential to change the voice of the NRA and the kind of broad, hard-edged messaging it's been doing beyond gun rights in recent years.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这确实有可能改变NRA的声音，改变它近年来在枪支权利之外所开展的广泛、强硬的信息传达方式。

sentences.en: So where does this leave the investigation by Letitia James, the New York attorney general?
sentences.zh: 那么，纽约州总检察长莱蒂蒂亚·詹姆斯（Letitia James）的调查将走向何方？

sentences.en: Well, that is really just starting.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那其实才刚刚开始。

sentences.en: On Friday, she sent letters to the NRA and several of its related groups informing them of the investigation, telling them to preserve documents.
sentences.zh: 周五，她向NRA及其几个相关组织发送了信函，通报了这项调查，并要求他们保存文件。

sentences.en: But it's really just a beginning.
sentences.zh: 但这真的只是个开始。

sentences.en: You know, I think Letitia James is going to be a thorn in the NRA's side for a long time to come.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为莱蒂蒂亚·詹姆斯在未来很长一段时间里都将是NRA的心头大患。

sentences.en: So clearly what you're describing here has been a genuine crisis for the NRA.
sentences.zh: 很显然，你刚才描述的情况对NRA来说是一场真正的危机。

sentences.en: But the NRA is extremely skilled at navigating crises.
sentences.zh: 但NRA在应对危机方面极其娴熟。

sentences.en: And we've talked a lot about it on The Daily, about the power of the NRA not being so much its ability at any moment to donate lots of money to politicians,
sentences.zh: 我们在《每日新闻》（The Daily）节目中经常讨论这一点，NRA的力量与其说在于它随时向政客捐赠大量资金的能力，

sentences.en: but instead its ability to turn the moments that seem like they're the greatest threats to the NRA's agenda, frequent mass shootings, into moments that actually strengthen the NRA.
sentences.zh: 不如说在于它能将那些看似对NRA议程构成最大威胁的时刻——比如频繁发生的大规模枪击事件——转化为实际上巩固NRA力量的契机。

sentences.en: Because it has deployed this playbook of activating its members to lobby lawmakers across the country to vote based on the way the NRA rates them.
sentences.zh: 因为它部署了一套行动手册：动员其成员在全国范围内游说立法者，让他们根据NRA对其的评级来进行投票。

sentences.en: So I wonder, does this latest episode, this power struggle, and even potentially the possibility of their NRA losing its tax-exempt status,
sentences.zh: 所以我想知道，最近发生的这件事，这场权力斗争，甚至可能连NRA失去免税资格的可能性，

sentences.en: does any of that change or dilute the NRA's power?
sentences.zh: 所有这一切是否会改变或削弱NRA的力量？

sentences.en: Well, you know, the NRA has always thrived on a sort of siege mentality.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，NRA一直靠一种围困心态蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: Look where we are today.
sentences.zh: 看看我们今天的处境。

sentences.en: Today, we're embroiled in controversy, where our opponents launch these rogue strategies, and they actually engage in order to take us down and take NRA down in unlawful behavior.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们卷入了争议之中，我们的对手发起了这些流氓策略，他们甚至采取行动来击垮我们，通过非法行为击垮NRA。

sentences.en: To turn these challenges into ways to rally their members.
sentences.zh: 将这些挑战转化为凝聚其成员的方式。

sentences.en: The governor's chosen candidate for attorney general
sentences.zh: 州长挑选的总检察长候选人

sentences.en: vowed to attack the NRA as a pillar of her campaign platform, even before she was elected into office.
sentences.zh: 在甚至还未当选公职之前，就誓言将攻击NRA作为其竞选纲领的支柱。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That was certainly in evidence at the convention this past weekend.
sentences.zh: 在上周末的大会上，这一点确实表现得淋漓尽致。

sentences.en: They hate our NRA.
sentences.zh: 他们恨我们的NRA。

sentences.en: They hate our freedom.
sentences.zh: 他们恨我们的自由。

sentences.en: And that's why we're going to keep fighting for you.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们要继续为你而战。

sentences.en: And that's why this case, what we're dealing right now, is perhaps the most important First Amendment case in the history of the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这个案子——我们目前正在处理的案子——也许是美利坚合众国历史上最重要的第一修正案案件。

sentences.en: But Danny, as you said, the NRA has, for a really long time, operated in the absence of a formidable opposition.
sentences.zh: 但丹尼，正如你所说，在很长一段时间里，NRA的运作都是在缺乏强大反对力量的情况下进行的。

sentences.en: And that is clearly changing.
sentences.zh: 而这种情况显然正在改变。

sentences.en: And I wonder if that will change its ability to weather what's now coming, whether it's Letitia James or the rest of the gun control movement.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这是否会改变它经受即将到来风雨的能力，无论是来自莱蒂蒂亚·詹姆斯还是其他控枪运动的力量。

sentences.en: You know, I think it's a much more even playing field than it's ever been, certainly financially.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为现在的竞争环境比以往任何时候都要公平得多，尤其是在资金方面。

sentences.en: And you see the gun control groups fighting at the state and local level in a way that they just didn't have the financial wherewithal to do in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到控枪集团在州和地方层面上展开斗争，这是他们在过去不具备财务实力去做的事情。

sentences.en: You know, I think for years the NRA operated at the state level without much opposition.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为多年来NRA在州一级运作时几乎没有遇到什么反对。

sentences.en: And now you have gun control groups that are really pushing back.
sentences.zh: 而现在，你有了真正进行反击的控枪集团。

sentences.en: It's a much more even fight than it's been in many years.
sentences.zh: 这是多年来最势均力敌的一场较量。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it feels very telling that opponents of the NRA were able to identify and exploit this vulnerability inside the NRA, this seemingly obscure issue of its tax status,
sentences.zh: NRA的反对者能够识别并利用NRA内部的这一脆弱点——即其税收状态这个看似晦涩的问题，

sentences.en: and completely rock the organization in the process.
sentences.zh: 并在此过程中彻底撼动整个组织，这让人觉得意味深长。

sentences.en: That they are savvier in a way that they haven't been before.
sentences.zh: 他们以一种前所未有的方式变得更加精明了。

sentences.en: And that maybe there's no longer an assumed world of advantage for the NRA.
sentences.zh: 也许NRA不再享有理所当然的绝对优势世界了。

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我认为是这样的。

sentences.en: It was just the threat of this investigation of the NRA's tax status that set off this chain of events that led us to where we are.
sentences.zh: 正是对NRA税收状态进行调查的威胁，引发了这一系列事件，把我们带到了今天这个地步。

sentences.en: And I think that tells us that the opponents of the NRA are learning more about how to get under the organization's skin.
sentences.zh: 我认为这告诉我们，NRA的对手正在更多地学习如何切中这个组织的要害。

sentences.en: And after the string of mass shootings there's been, I think they're more motivated than they've ever been.
sentences.zh: 在经历了这一系列大规模枪击事件之后，我认为他们比以往任何时候都更有动力。

sentences.en: Danny, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 丹尼，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月呢？

sentences.en: For free.
sentences.zh: 免费的。

sentences.en: Without putting in a credit card.
sentences.zh: 无需输入信用卡。

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Monday, Deputy Attorney General Rod Rosenstein, who appointed the special counsel and oversaw much of his investigation, submitted his letter of resignation.
sentences.zh: 周一，任命了特别检察官并监督其大部分调查的副总检察长罗德·罗森斯坦（Rod Rosenstein）递交了他的辞职信。

sentences.en: During his brief, controversial tenure,
sentences.zh: 在他短暂且充满争议的任期内，

sentences.en: Rosenstein became so alarmed by President Trump's conduct, The Times found, that he suggested secretly recording him and recruiting cabinet members to invoke the 25th Amendment
sentences.zh: 据《时报》报道，罗森斯坦对特朗普总统的行为感到如此惊恐，以至于他建议秘密录下与他的对话，并招募内阁成员来援引第二十五修正案

sentences.en: to remove Trump from office.
sentences.zh: 将特朗普罢免。

sentences.en: But in his resignation letter, Rosenstein praised the president and said he was honored to serve him.
sentences.zh: 但在辞职信中，罗森斯坦赞扬了总统，并表示很荣幸能为他服务。

sentences.en: And for the first time in five years, the Islamic State released a video of the group's reclusive leader, Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi,
sentences.zh: 五年来，伊斯兰国首次发布了一段该组织深居简出的领导人阿布·贝克尔·巴格达迪（Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi）的视频，

sentences.en: suggesting that he has survived the defeat of ISIS's territorial home.
sentences.zh: 表明他在ISIS领土大本营的失败中幸存了下来。

sentences.en: Sitting on a mattress with a machine gun by his side, al-Baghdadi acknowledged that ISIS has lost its once sprawling caliphate in Iraq and Syria to U.S.-backed forces,
sentences.zh: 巴格达迪坐在床垫上，身旁放着一把机枪，他承认ISIS在伊拉克和叙利亚曾经庞大的哈里发国已经输给了美国支持的部队，

sentences.en: and he congratulated the perpetrators of the Easter Sunday suicide bombings in Sri Lanka, an attack for which ISIS has claimed responsibility.
sentences.zh: 并向斯里兰卡复活节周日自杀式炸弹袭击的肇事者表示祝贺，ISIS已宣称对该袭击负责。

sentences.en: Those attacks and Monday's video are the latest sign that ISIS intends to remain an active terror group despite its military setbacks.
sentences.zh: 这些袭击和周一的视频是最新迹象，表明ISIS尽管遭受了军事挫折，仍打算作为一个活跃的恐怖组织存续下去。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客人在家一样舒适的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是全黑睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会晕倒过去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有对某种东西过敏或对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用中或您喜欢的任何地方收听《Wirecutter秀》。
